extraction.Name: Robert Hill
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 320 acre allotment, for he did not want to pay taxes; but he was told that he would have to accept it, so he did so
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the Durland Trust Company, of Norfolk, Nebraska, for $4000.00; sold to Clyde Childers, of Harrington, South Dakota, for $10,400.00, Mr. Childers assuming the mortgage of $5500.00 in favor of the Durland Trust Company, and also assumed the back taxes at that time amounting to $1200.00, receiving $700.00 in cash, and the balance amounting to $3200.00 in monthly payments of $85.00 per month
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he does not consider that he received a good price for his land, on account of being mortgaged he had to sell at a disadvantage; Childers assumed back taxes amounting to $1200.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: lives on a rented place and milks cows, also, this $85.00 per month helps comprise his income
extraction.NOTES: Mortgaged land in 1922 for stock and improvements; sold in December 1927; has never received any aid from the County or Government; mentally competent, health not very good; has a wife and six children to support, all of whom have good health; document number 2456; sworn November 20, 1928
